'''Nogometni klub Nafta 1903''' or simply '''NK Nafta 1903''' is a Slovenian [[Association football|football]] club from [[Lendava]] which plays in the [[Slovenian PrvaLiga]], the top tier of Slovenian football. The club was founded in 2012 as a [[Phoenix club (sports)|phoenix club]] of [[NK Nafta Lendava]], which disbanded the same year due to financial problems.<ref name="Nafta"/>"}}
